notes.text:
RIGHT MAG ONLY: JG2. Current-limit and accessory startup require measurement.
U8/Q3/Q7/Q9 retain fault, presence and default-OFF protection.
Q4/Q6 isolate IRQ between switched and Core domains.
DET is a passive contact to GND; switched pull-ups and TCA4307 retained.
Left MAG is retired. SWJ1 uses GPIO38/40/41 on Main_Control.
No Core-to-ISO ground bridge. ESD qualification remains open.
MCU + reset / BOOT / debug: existing firmware GPIO map

RevC INPUTS: OH49E x4 -> RC -> ADS1015 U20, I2C 0x48.
EC56-HA1 is the frozen encoder direction; exact mounting/pin map pending.
JE1 retains prototype A/B GPIO1/2; JS1 is independent screen press GPIO39.

5V_CORE must be regulated / current-limited upstream.
Not raw USB-C / PD. 2A converter rating is not a USB power budget.
Do not parallel this 3V3 output with future Hub regulator.
JPOWER1 and L1 exact physical parts remain selection gates.

Harness pin numbers are new PCB pad numbers, not the LCD FPC order.
Preserve actual module silk CS/SCK/D0..D3 and SDA/SCL/3V3/GND.
One upstream I2C pull-up set only. QSPI return uses adjacent power harness.
PC-HUB RevC CONTROL | MANUFACTURING_NOT_RELEASED
ESP32 USB FULL-SPEED Device/HID/PC Agent | internal Hub branch pending
3V3 CONTROL RAIL: AP63203 fixed-output reference topology

SWJ1 SLLB510100: 1=GPIO38, T=GPIO40, 2=GPIO41; C=GND.
Product actions: up=record, push=system mute, down=Agent notification center.
Verify physical up/down against final mounted orientation; do not infer from pad names.

JU1 pin1 NC: no VBUS back-feed. Supply Core through JPOWER1.
This is an internal USB2 branch, not a USB-C receptacle / USB3 port.
External test adapter must provide connector-side ESD protection.
Keep D+/D- paired and short; final high-speed layout is a separate gate.

Select only ONE mux channel at a time. Never select 0x03 with identical slaves.
DRV REG capacitor = 1uF; IN/TRIG = GND; EN pulled high; use I2C standby/GO.
HAPTIC_VDD defaults to 3V3, not unregulated USB 5V. Motor rated/overdrive settings NOT verified.
Motor OUT+/OUT- float: neither is GND. On motor six test pads, outermost two only; insulate middle four.

RevC full scope retained: main Hub, USB2 CTRL/ISO branches, PC-C and optional Dock power.
Missing circuits require verified parts, physical pin maps, source budgets and stackup.
EC56 direct Core mounting is preferred; dimensions/support are mechanical gates.
Keep JE1/JU1 until their complete replacements are verified. Motors mount to shell.

WROOM-1 electrical pinout = WROOM-1U; explicit 1U footprint.
N16R8: GPIO35/36/37 reserved by Octal PSRAM.
Unused GPIOs are NC; antenna cable and antenna remain external.
HAPTICS: mux 0x70; channel0 LEFT / channel1 RIGHT; each driver 0x5A

JS1 is the independent screen-press interface on GPIO39.
JE1 legacy pin4 shares this net; do not add a second encoder push function.
JE1 pin2/3 are encoder A/B on GPIO1/2; EC56 package and installation pending.

JG1 left MAG retired; JG2 right MAG remains on TCA9546 CH1.
GPIO10=RGB DATA; GPIO42=RGB_EN. CH0 remains unused.
SWJ1 uses GPIO38/40/41. Four keys use linear Hall sensors and ADS1015.
Screen press GPIO39, display/touch and INMP441 are retained formal functions.

JM1 is the formal INMP441 daughterboard interface, populated in RevC.
1=3V3, 2=GND, 3=BCLK GPIO4, 4=WS GPIO5, 5=SD GPIO17, 6=L/R low.
Daughterboard decoupling, acoustic placement and I2S runtime validation remain required.
JA1 historical amplifier interface is absent; no speaker circuit is introduced here.
RevC MICROPHONE: independent INMP441 daughterboard interface
DISPLAY / TOUCH HARNESSES
RevC Hall acquisition | U20 address 0x48
AIN0..3 = Hall 1..4. TP20..23 provide access before each RC.
OH49E footprint uses physical package map from JSMICRO p.2.
ALERT/RDY intentionally open. MCU polls I2C conversions.
RevC RGB | Default-off supply and 3.3-to-5 V data

RGB_EN=GPIO42 with default-low bias; TP24 is a test point.
GPIO10 drives U22 level translation; U21 switches RGB power.
Start RMT low; send zero frame after power-up. Cut RGB_EN on failure.
QOD discharges the switched RGB rail through R72.

One RevC Core main board. H1..H4 are saved candidate mounting anchors, not assembly freeze.
Motors mount to load-bearing shell; all mechanical interfaces use product coordinates.
The RevB filename is retained as project identity, not product authority.
PC-HUB / MAIN BOARD / RevC
One physical main PCB: control circuitry is the Main_Control hierarchical sheet.

INCOMPLETE FOR FAB: USB Hub, PC/Dock power selection, USB3 receptacles and Dock high-speed
connector are not implemented. Main_Control netlist does not imply these functions exist.
Motor drive settings and final component placement/routing require further validation.
